body_markdown:
#### Friday, Nov. 13 – 3 p.m. Pacific Time


Flights for Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines are impacted by a nationwide ground stop issued this afternoon by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).


The ground stop is halting departing flights for all airlines, including ours, at their origin. Flights within the state of Alaska and Neighbor Island flights in Hawai’i are not impacted. Flights between the West Coast and Hawai’i can continue, and international flights from Honolulu have also been cleared for departure. Aircraft in the air are continuing to their destinations.


Because of the significance of the ground stop, we have canceled some flights and diverted others. For guests who need to adjust their travel plans, we have a[flexible travel policy in place.](https://www.alaskaair.com/content/advisories/travel-advisories?lid=AS_Footer_advisories)


When the ground stop is lifted, it will take time for our operations to get back on track for the rest of the day. We continue to advise guests to check their flight status before heading to the airport at[alaskaair.com](https://www.alaskaair.com/) and[hawaiianairlines.com](https://www.hawaiianairlines.com/) , and our mobile app.
